objective: Local exploratory transfer of DROID-Splat fixed-pose scale alignment into an isolated DROID-W candidate
remote_operations: FORBIDDEN: no SSH, remote process, resource or file changes
buffer_explanation: Common local capacity; at most64 retained frames plus16 filler slots, no eviction allowed. Does not alter remote500-slot protocol.
scope: Frontend main-loop local BA, excluding initialization, final BA and filler
scale_model: scale-only weighted least-squares in disparity; shift=0
fit_map: estimated current geometry; cameras fixed; newest candidate excluded
eligibility: at least2-view depth consistency using native depth_filter threshold0.05; depth-positive; disparity>.01*mean and>1e-3; correspondence weight>.1; >=300pixels
scale_invalid: nonfinite or<.05: identity fallback; never clip to a favourable outcome
A5: Existing TASK011B coefficient_map ValidityAwareMax; only depth regularization strength is changed, not UBA weights
local_compatibility: Metric3D optional xFormers replaced by equivalent PyTorch SDPA
interpretation: One Train development window and one seed establish only bounded exploratory evidence. No per-segment scale fit, no GT in inference, no metric-scale recovery claim. Report all successful and failed arms.
